description: This file manages restart sentinel events in a gateway system, including scheduling wake events, delivering notifications, and handling restart-related logic.

methods.name: enqueueRestartSentinelWake
methods.description: Enqueues a system event and requests an immediate heartbeat to wake the system for restart handling.

methods.name: waitForOutboundRetry
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a specified delay, used for retrying outbound delivery.

methods.name: deliverRestartSentinelNotice
methods.description: Attempts to deliver a restart sentinel notification with retries and error handling.

methods.name: scheduleRestartSentinelWake
methods.description: Main function to schedule a restart sentinel wake event, process session info, and deliver notifications.

methods.name: shouldWakeFromRestartSentinel
methods.description: Determines if the system should wake from restart sentinel based on environment variables.
